subject:
**** Request for Quotation – Tender Ref. GEM/2026/B/TEST_CLEAN – 2V 500 Ah VRLA Cells  

**
draft_body:
**  

Dear Sir/Madam,  

**Reference:** Tender GEM/2026/B/TEST_CLEAN  
**Procuring Authority:** Gas Authority of India Limited (GAIL)  
**Project Title:** Battery Bank – SITC  

Volks Energie, on behalf of GAIL, hereby invites your esteemed organization, as an **Authorized OEM Partner**, to submit a formal quotation for the supply of the item(s) detailed below.  

---

### 1. Itemized Bill of Quantities (BoQ) & Technical Requirements  

| # | Item Description                | Quantity | Unit | Technical Specification | Delivery Location | Required By Date |
|---|--------------------------------|----------|------|--------------------------|-------------------|------------------|
| 1 | 2 V 500 Ah VRLA Cells           | 100      | Nos  | IS 15549                 | Visakhapatnam     | 30 Sep 2026      |

---

### 2. Commercial & Delivery Constraints  

- **Delivery Timeline:** 60 days from receipt of purchase order (please confirm lead time in weeks/days).  
- **Payment Terms:** 100 % against receipt and acceptance of goods.  

---

### 3. Information Required in Your Quotation  

Please provide the following details for each line item:  

1. **Unit Price** (exclusive of GST) in INR.  
2. **Lead Time** – expressed in weeks and/or days.  
3. **GST Breakdown** – applicable GST rate and total GST amount per unit and for the full order.  
4. **Technical Compliance Sheet** – confirming conformity to IS 15549 and any additional certifications or test reports.  
5. **Validity** of the quotation (minimum 90 days).  
6. **Any applicable freight, insurance, or handling charges** (if not FOB).  

---

### 4. Submission Instructions  

- Submit your quotation in PDF format to **procurement@volksenergie.in** no later than **submission deadline**.  
- The subject line of the email must read: **“RFQ – GEM/2026/B/TEST_CLEAN – 2V 500 Ah VRLA Cells”**.  
- All technical documents, GST certificates, and compliance statements must be attached.  

---

### 5. Evaluation Criteria  

Quotations will be evaluated on price competitiveness, adherence to technical specifications, delivery lead time, and completeness of GST and compliance documentation.  

---

We appreciate your prompt attention to this request and look forward to receiving a comprehensive quotation at the earliest. Should you require any clarification, please contact **Mr. Arvind Kumar, Procurement Manager** at **+91‑98765‑43210** or via email at **arvind.kumar@volksenergie.in**.  

Thank you for your cooperation.  

Yours sincerely,  

**[Your Name]**  
Senior Procurement & Supply Chain Specialist  
Volks Energie
